req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to verify the requirement that the system serves an interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs. The tests include a positive case to ensure the endpoint returns the expected Swagger UI, a negative case to handle potential client errors, and a boundary case to test the system's response to edge conditions.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to an invalid endpoint /docs-invalid.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs-invalid')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with a large query string.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
large_query = '?' + 'a' * 2048
response = client.get('/docs' + large_query)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text
